list.query: SELECT CURRENT_DATE::TEXT AS sftp_date UNION SELECT DISTINCT sftp_date::TEXT FROM trades_cleaned.clear_street_trades WHERE give_in_out_firm_num IN ('ADU', '905') ORDER BY sftp_date DESC LIMIT 30;

options.content:
## Clear Street Trades to MUFG

End-to-end pipeline that ingests trade files from Clear Street's SFTP server, transforms them through dbt, and sends filtered trades to MUFG via SFTP.

### Pipeline Phases

| Phase | Input | Process | Output |
|-------|-------|---------|--------|
| **1. Ingest** | Clear Street SFTP (`Helios_Transactions_*.csv`) | SSH key auth, 5-day lookback, parse CSV, cast dtypes, upsert | `clear_street.helios_transactions_v2_2026_feb_23` |
| **2. dbt Transform** | Raw ingestion table | source > staging (clean cols, product codes) > mart views | `trades_cleaned.clear_street_trades` + `clear_street_trades_grouped` |
| **3. Send to MUFG** | `trades_cleaned.clear_street_trades` | Filter firms `ADU`/`905` on latest date, export CSV | MUFG SFTP (`Helios_Transactions_{YYYYMMDD}_filtered.csv`) |

**Full workflow diagram**: [Clear Street Trades to MUFG](https://mango-flower-02564110f.2.azurestaticapps.net/domains/positions-and-trades/workflows/#clear-street-trades-to-mufg) *(docs site)*

targets.rawSql: WITH sftp_files AS (SELECT CAST(trade_date_from_sftp AS DATE) AS trade_date, MAX(sftp_upload_timestamp) AS file_released_on_sftp FROM clear_street.helios_transactions_v2_2026_feb_23 GROUP BY CAST(trade_date_from_sftp AS DATE)), sftp_downloads AS (SELECT event_timestamp AS downloaded_at FROM logging.pipeline_runs WHERE pipeline_name = 'helios_transactions_v2_2026_feb_23' AND event_type = 'RUN_SUCCESS'), mufg_releases AS (SELECT event_timestamp AS released_to_mufg_at FROM logging.pipeline_runs WHERE pipeline_name = 'send_clear_street_trades_to_mufg_v1_2026_feb_02' AND event_type = 'RUN_SUCCESS') SELECT TO_CHAR(sf.trade_date, 'Dy Mon-DD') AS "Trade Date", TO_CHAR(sf.file_released_on_sftp, 'Dy Mon-DD HH:MI:SS AM') AS "Clear Street Released at SFTP", TO_CHAR(dl.downloaded_at, 'Dy Mon-DD HH:MI:SS AM') AS "File Downloaded", TO_CHAR(mr.released_to_mufg_at, 'Dy Mon-DD HH:MI:SS AM') AS "File Released to MUFG" FROM sftp_files sf LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT downloaded_at FROM sftp_downloads WHERE downloaded_at >= sf.file_released_on_sftp ORDER BY downloaded_at ASC LIMIT 1) dl ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT released_to_mufg_at FROM mufg_releases WHERE released_to_mufg_at >= dl.downloaded_at ORDER BY released_to_mufg_at ASC LIMIT 1) mr ON true ORDER BY sf.file_released_on_sftp DESC LIMIT 3;

SELECT pipeline_name, hostname, TO_CHAR(event_timestamp, 'Dy Mon-DD HH:MI:SS AM') AS event_timestamp, error_type, error_message FROM logging.pipeline_runs WHERE pipeline_name = 'helios_transactions_v2_2026_feb_23' AND event_timestamp::DATE = '${sftp_date}'::DATE ORDER BY event_timestamp DESC;

SELECT pipeline_name, hostname, TO_CHAR(event_timestamp, 'Dy Mon-DD HH:MI:SS AM') AS event_timestamp, error_type, error_message FROM logging.pipeline_runs WHERE pipeline_name = 'send_clear_street_trades_to_mufg_v1_2026_feb_02' AND event_timestamp::DATE = '${sftp_date}'::DATE ORDER BY event_timestamp DESC;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity_cleaned), 0) AS titan_qty FROM trades_cleaned.clear_street_trades WHERE give_in_out_firm_num IN ('ADU', '905') AND sftp_date = '${sftp_date}'::DATE AND account_name = 'TITAN';
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity_cleaned), 0) AS titan_qty FROM trades_cleaned.clear_street_trades WHERE sftp_date = '${sftp_date}'::DATE AND account_name = 'TITAN';

SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN give_in_out_firm_num IN ('ADU', '905') THEN quantity_cleaned END), 0) = COALESCE(SUM(quantity_cleaned), 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS match FROM trades_cleaned.clear_street_trades WHERE sftp_date = '${sftp_date}'::DATE AND account_name = 'TITAN';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS missing_count FROM trades_cleaned.clear_street_trades WHERE sftp_date = '${sftp_date}'::DATE AND (product_code_grouping IS NULL OR product_code_grouping = '') AND give_in_out_firm_num IN ('ADU', '905');

WITH TRADES AS (SELECT sftp_date, account_number_cleaned AS clear_street_account, account_name, exchange_name_cleaned AS exchange_name, product_code_grouping, product_code_region, exch_comm_cd AS exchange_code, is_option, put_call, strike_price, contract_year_month AS contract_yyyymm, security_description AS contract_description, bbg_product_code, ice_product_code, trade_price, settlement_price, quantity_cleaned AS qty FROM trades_cleaned.clear_street_trades WHERE give_in_out_firm_num IN ('ADU', '905') AND sftp_date = '${sftp_date}'::DATE AND account_name IS NOT NULL) SELECT sftp_date::TEXT, clear_street_account, exchange_name, product_code_grouping, product_code_region, exchange_code, put_call, strike_price, contract_yyyymm, bbg_product_code, ice_product_code, ROUND(AVG(trade_price)::NUMERIC, 4) AS trade_price_total, ROUND(AVG(settlement_price)::NUMERIC, 4) AS settlement_price, SUM(qty) AS qty_total, SUM(CASE WHEN account_name = 'ACIM' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS qty_acim, SUM(CASE WHEN account_name = 'ANDY' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS qty_andy, SUM(CASE WHEN account_name = 'MAC' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS qty_mac, SUM(CASE WHEN account_name = 'PNT' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS qty_pnt, SUM(CASE WHEN account_name = 'DICKSON' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS qty_dickson, SUM(CASE WHEN account_name = 'TITAN' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS qty_titan FROM TRADES GROUP BY sftp_date, clear_street_account, exchange_name, product_code_grouping, product_code_region, exchange_code, is_option, put_call, strike_price, contract_yyyymm, contract_description, bbg_product_code, ice_product_code ORDER BY clear_street_account, product_code_grouping, product_code_region, contract_yyyymm;

targets.rawSql: WITH TRADES AS (SELECT sftp_date, account_number_cleaned AS clear_street_account, account_name, exchange_name_cleaned AS exchange_name, product_code_grouping, product_code_region, exch_comm_cd AS exchange_code, is_option, put_call, strike_price, contract_year_month AS contract_yyyymm, security_description AS contract_description, bbg_product_code, ice_product_code, trade_price, settlement_price, quantity_cleaned AS qty FROM trades_cleaned.clear_street_trades WHERE sftp_date = '${sftp_date}'::DATE AND account_name IS NOT NULL) SELECT sftp_date::TEXT, clear_street_account, exchange_name, product_code_grouping, product_code_region, exchange_code, put_call, strike_price, contract_yyyymm, bbg_product_code, ice_product_code, ROUND(AVG(trade_price)::NUMERIC, 4) AS trade_price_total, ROUND(AVG(settlement_price)::NUMERIC, 4) AS settlement_price, SUM(qty) AS qty_total, SUM(CASE WHEN account_name = 'ACIM' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS qty_acim, SUM(CASE WHEN account_name = 'ANDY' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS qty_andy, SUM(CASE WHEN account_name = 'MAC' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS qty_mac, SUM(CASE WHEN account_name = 'PNT' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS qty_pnt, SUM(CASE WHEN account_name = 'DICKSON' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS qty_dickson, SUM(CASE WHEN account_name = 'TITAN' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS qty_titan FROM TRADES GROUP BY sftp_date, clear_street_account, exchange_name, product_code_grouping, product_code_region, exchange_code, is_option, put_call, strike_price, contract_yyyymm, contract_description, bbg_product_code, ice_product_code ORDER BY clear_street_account, product_code_grouping, product_code_region, contract_yyyymm;

SELECT sftp_date::TEXT, trade_date::TEXT, give_in_out_firm_num AS firm, account_number_cleaned AS account, exchange_name_cleaned AS exchange, security_description, buy_sell_cleaned AS buy_sell, quantity_cleaned AS quantity, trade_price, settlement_price, product_code_grouping, product_code_region, ice_product_code, cme_product_code FROM trades_cleaned.clear_street_trades WHERE give_in_out_firm_num IN ('ADU', '905') AND sftp_date = '${sftp_date}'::DATE ORDER BY product_code_grouping, product_code_region, security_description;

SELECT sftp_date::TEXT, trade_date::TEXT, give_in_out_firm_num AS firm, account_number_cleaned AS account, exchange_name_cleaned AS exchange, security_description, buy_sell_cleaned AS buy_sell, quantity_cleaned AS quantity, trade_price, settlement_price, product_code_grouping, product_code_region, ice_product_code, cme_product_code FROM trades_cleaned.clear_street_trades WHERE sftp_date = '${sftp_date}'::DATE ORDER BY product_code_grouping, product_code_region, security_description;
